Did Halloween finish differently from plan?

When Maya recognizes an earlier pattern, Meridian reopens it without mixing the evidence.
We saw this before. Pull in that case—and watch Western Europe.
The analyst joins the call, continues in Slack, and keeps working after the meeting ends.
Meridian. Commerce intelligence for what comes next.
